name: backbone
description: Give your JS App some Backbone with Models, Views, Collections, and Events.
author: Jeremy Ashkenas

scripts.test: karma start && coffee test/model.coffee && yarn lint
scripts.build-debug: rollup -e backbone -f umd -g backbone:Backbone -n Backbone.debugInfo -o debug-info.js --no-strict modules/debug-info.js
scripts.mark-release: replace-in-file MARK_DEVELOPMENT MARK_RELEASE modules/debug-info.js && yarn build-debug
scripts.mark-develop: replace-in-file MARK_RELEASE MARK_DEVELOPMENT modules/debug-info.js && yarn build-debug
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn test && yarn mark-release && yarn build && yarn alias-sourcemap && yarn doc && git add -u && yarn mark-develop
